User Story:
As a user, I want to create a personal page with a semi-structured format so that others can easily learn about my background, interests, and skills.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The page includes sections for background, interests, and skills.
- Each section allows for a minimum of 100 characters and a maximum of 500 characters.
- The layout is visually appealing and easy to navigate.

Test Outline:
- Verify that each section is present and meets the character requirements.
- Check the layout for visual appeal and ease of navigation.

User Story:
As a professional seeking certification, I want to complete the application process to become a Certified Scrum Practitioner so that I can enhance my credentials and demonstrate my expertise in Scrum practices.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The application form is fully completed and submitted by the deadline.
- All required documentation is attached to the application.
- Confirmation of application receipt is received within 48 hours.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the application form is filled out correctly and submitted on time.
- Check that all necessary documents are included with the application.
As a Practitioner, I want to include additional details about me in my profile page, so that I can showcase my experience.
As a site member, I want to fill out an application to become a Certified Scrum Trainer, so that I can teach CSM and CSPO courses and certify others.
As a Trainer, I want to include additional details in my profile page about me, so that others can learn about me and decide if I am the right trainer for them.
